subject: Rebaseline POC scope: adding intent-classification use case
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsys.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@healthsys.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + POC success criteria (next steps)

Hi Alicia / Tom -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we're aligned before we kick off the POC: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: reduce average turnaround on claims triage routing and improve intent classification accuracy for ambiguous requests.
- Target outcome: move to automated routing for 60% of low-risk claims and 30% reduction in manual triage time for flagged intents.
- Data: will provide a sample of 100k anonymized support transactions and expected intents mapping.

Proposed POC scope (2-week technical evaluation + 2-week business validation)
- Technical: ingest sample data, run Redwood inference on two workflows (routing + intent-classification), measure precision/recall at thresholds you care about.
- Business validation: evaluate downstream impact on triage throughput and agent workload over a 2-week pilot on a 10% traffic slice.
- Success criteria (initial): intent-classification F1 >= 0.78 on the labeled eval set; routing accuracy lift >= 12% vs current baseline; no PII leakage in logs.

Owners & timeline
- Redwood owner: me (Marissa) + Rishi (solutions) for model/config.
- HealthSys owner: Alicia (product lead) + Tom (ops).
- Proposed kickoff: Mon, Aug 17. Technical run: Aug 17-30. Business validation: Aug 31-Sep 13.

Attachments: attached a POC proposal and SOW draft for review.

Next steps
1) Please confirm success criteria and the kickoff date.
2) If procurement needs anything, loop them in - we can produce a short security addendum.

Thanks - I'll wait for your go/no-go and any changes to the criteria.


Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0143

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@healthsys.com>, procurement@healthsys.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC success criteria (next steps)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the detailed note - this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our side after reviewing with the product team: 

1) We want to add a third use case to the POC: intent classification for refund/chargeback requests. That's a high-volume category and we want to validate Redwood on that intent specifically.
2) Success criteria: can we add a business metric? In addition to F1 >= 0.78, we want to see a 20% reduction in mean handle time for refund requests in the pilot slice.
3) Timeline: Aug 17 kickoff still works but we'll need an extra week for labeling the refund dataset. Can the technical run be extended by one week (technical run Aug 17-Sep 6) and business validation Sep 7-Sep 20?

Also looping procurement (copied) - they'll need the SOW redline and our vendor questionnaire answers. Alicia will share the questionnaire by EOD.

If adding refund intent materially changes scope/cost, please flag.

Best,
Alicia
Head of Product, Customer Experience | HealthSys
agomez@healthsys.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsys.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC success criteria (next steps)

Alicia -

Appreciate the quick review and the clear ask. Short responses below and proposed re-baseline: 

1) Adding refund/chargeback intent: doable. That will require an additional labeled set (we can help label up to 5k examples quickly if you provide raw exports) and a minor config change to the classification head.

2) New success criteria: we can include the business metric for refund MHT (mean handle time) reduction target of 20% during business validation - will require baseline MHT from you.

3) Timeline rebaseline: agree to shift technical run to Aug 17-Sep 6 (3 weeks) and business validation to Sep 7-Sep 20 (2 weeks). That pushes final readout to Sep 21.

4) Scope/cost: because this expands the labeled work and evaluation to an additional intent, there will be a modest scope delta. I estimate an extra 0.5 FTE of labeling and a $8k one-time labeling/config fee. I'll confirm with Rishi and send an updated SOW.

Action items I'll take now:
- Rishi: can you confirm labeling estimate and timing?
- Vivek: can you confirm we can support the extra intent in the same evaluation pipeline and whether it impacts the agent for the pilot slice?
- Alicia: please send the baseline MHT and the procurement questionnaire when ready.

If everyone's aligned, I'll send an updated POC proposal and SOW with redlines by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks - Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsys.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC success criteria (next steps)

Marissa / team -

Confirmed on the labeling and eval pipeline:
- We can mobilize a labeling batch for the refund intent - up to 5k examples in 5 business days (assuming HealthSys provides raw exports and basic schemas).
- No changes required to the serving runtime; evaluation pipeline can run the extra intent in parallel.
- The $8k estimate for the labeling/config fee looks correct (covers labeler hours + QA).

I'll prep the redlined SOW and a one-pager that calls out the rebaseline and delta. Will loop in PM Ops if we need extra guardrails for the pilot slice.

Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthsys.com>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@healthsys.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, procurement@healthsys.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Updated POC proposal & next steps (rebaseline accepted)

Hi Alicia / Tom -

Thanks - we're aligned. Per Rishi's note, Redwood will: 
- Add the refund/chargeback intent to the POC evaluation. We'll label up to 5k examples (5 business days after receiving raw exports).
- Update success criteria to include: intent-classification F1 >= 0.78 AND refund MHT reduction >= 20% during the business validation window.
- Update timeline: Technical run Aug 17-Sep 6; Business validation Sep 7-Sep 20; Final readout Sep 21.
- Cost delta: one-time $8k labeling/config fee.

Attachments: POC-Proposal-v2.pdf (updated scope), SOW-HealthSys-draft.docx (redline included).

Next immediate steps for HealthSys
1) Share raw exports for refund intents (S3 link or secure share) by EOD Fri, Aug 14 so labeling can begin on Mon, Aug 17.
2) Provide baseline MHT numbers for refund requests by Aug 14.
3) Procurement: review the redlined SOW and vendor questionnaire. If DocuSign is preferred we can route the SOW.

If procurement confirms the SOW, we'll begin labeling on Aug 17 and keep you updated in a shared doc. I'll also add a short mutual action plan to the hubspot deal (link attached).

Thanks everyone - looking forward to getting this kicked off.


Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0143
